Mar Vista Grande: the county's taxable assessment per unit, in aggregate, and the tax it implies at the 2026 North Myrtle Beach rental-rate levy
millage (221.2 mills; ledger CON row 21). Source: Horry County GIS layer 24 (AssessedProp, TaxableProp, MarketProp).
Kept: for units taxed at the 6 percent rate, the count and the median and quartiles of TaxableProp and of MarketProp, and the
implied yearly tax (AssessedProp, which is 6 percent of TaxableProp, x 221.2 / 1000, before any credit or fee on the bill). No unit's own record.
Run: python3 -I pull_tax.py <this dir>. Writes tax.json.
